summary: Koochiching County tower 82, a 94-ft ladder tower erected in 1930 and later removed; its old rail-line site is now the Blue Ox Trail.

facts.status_note: The county survey says the tower was removed, with no year given; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as gone
facts.agency: Minnesota Forest Service (owner listed as Mn MFS)

visit.trail_note: The tower is gone. The Blue Ox Trail follows the old rail grade and is open to ATVs in summer and snowmobiles in winter

access.note: The Blue Ox Trail runs along the old rail line and is open to ATVs in summer and snowmobiles in winter. No source describes what remains at the tower site

events.note: Tower number 82 erected in 1930, in the hamlet of Gemmell along the old rail line

evidence.quote: Gemmell was a 94 foot, maybe Aermotor, ladder tower.

notes_for_editor: Removal year not given anywhere; the county survey says only 'Removed'. Manufacturer uncertain ('maybe Aermotor'). The exact tower spot within the hamlet is unknown and no source describes what remains. Coordinates match FFLA (47.9724, -94.1280 in the survey). The record's status 'gone' is supported. Possible follow-up: Koochiching County or Minnesota DNR forestry records and Big Falls or Northome newspaper archives.
